name: thread-steps
title: Thread Steps
description: An ordered sequence held together by Interlace's woven thread: a knot for each step, and two strands that cross between one knot and the next. The strands draw in as the reader reaches each step, so the motion says one thing only: this leads to that.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/thread-steps

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/thread-steps.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/thread-steps';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/thread-steps

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
